'''Cruegar''' was a [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] from [[Kinyen/Legends|Kinyen]] who later settled on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] and owned the [[The Paddocks|Paddocks]], a large open-air market in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]].
